reviews.text: As a first time dog owner, I was absolutely mortified when I found out my three year-old doggo needed tplo surgery for a torn ccl. It took a couple weeks for my primary vet to get back to me with my dogs x-rays and within that time I had spent an unhealthy amount of time on reddit and TikTok Consuming misinformation that made me very anxious for this surgery. Especially as a single dog dad who works a full and part-time job, The prospect of my dog undergoing this type of surgery was nerve racking. However, the team did such a great job of explaining everything in detail and giving me the confidence that my dog was in good hands. I was given so much information on aftercare and they checked in and made sure everything was going good with my boy. I was also very surprised by how soon they were able to get me in for surgery especially since it took about a month for my primary vet to let me know that surgery was the next step. We are about a month post clearance and my dog is back to his normal self. I’m so grateful for the great lengths the team went to ensure that me and my dog were comfortable. Thank you so much <3
Wonderful, caring team from doctor all the way to office staff.

Dr. Farrell and his team are fantastic. My six year old pit bull needed TPLO surgery on both of his back legs. Dr. Farrell walked us through the procedure and what we should expect for recovery. His team was very accommodating along the way. Before the surgeries, my pup was struggling to walk. Now, he’s running, playing and back to full activity.

These people are a amazing!

I was a bit nervous about finding the right pro to perform this surgery on my little one. In my first call with AOS, Tina dissolved every piece of anxiety I had. Dr. Farrell's video on the TPLO surgery is equally disarming, and then I got to meet him in person, which was even better. Chris was a great blend of warm and no-nonsense when he briefed me on what to expect.

I felt instantly comforted and at ease with the entire team, and my little Pono walked out of the building on the day of surgery, just like Dr. Farrell said she would.

My payment - which was far cheaper than I had been quoted elsewhere! -- included everything... surgery, prep, post-op check-ins, text messages, exercises, detailed instructions, meds, and a really positive and helpful vibe. Like, they genuinely care! I'm so GRATEFUL to the whole AOS team! CALL THEM!

All in all, this team is top-notch! I'm an AOS fan, and you will be too!

Fantastic clinic! They did a TPLO surgery for my large dog and did an amazing job. The pricing was great, and their communication was top-notch. They were always available to answer my questions during his recovery. Highly recommend!
Thank you for the 5 star review!
Amazing surgeons. They’re so kind and attentive. Had 2 CCL surgeries here and they did both of them perfectly

My pitbull recently had TPLO surgery here, and so far the results have been excellent. The cost of the surgery was very reasonable, and the entire staff was incredibly caring, knowledgeable, and attentive. They took the time to answer all of my questions both before and after the procedure, which gave me great peace of mind throughout the process. I truly felt that my dog was in good hands. I highly recommend them to anyone who loves their four-legged family member and wants the best possible care for them. ❤️🐾

Dr. Ferrell and staff are amazing. They took such great care of my Sophie through every step of her ripped ACL surgery and recovery. I hope your dog never goes through this but if they do, I hope you go to Blue Sky Vets, the best in the business.

Our little boy suffered a knee injury requiring surgery to fix his luxating patella. Surgeon and team were extremely knowledgeable and professional, making the experience for us fur baby parents a little easier. They provided follow up care and were easy to get ahold of when we had questions. Would recommend to anyone whose puppers requires an ortho surgery. Thanks to the team for their amazing work… Baby boy, Angel, is almost all the way back 💕

Dr. Farrell and his whole staff is awesome , awesome i can't began to say how much they all took care of our American Bully ,Bear after screening bear for surgery for a mass in his muzzle , Dr.Farrell found lumps in Bear's chest after testing he had lymphoma so he couldn't proform the surgery. Dr. Farrell continued to support Bear by finding a doctor who could care for his condition.

Cookie is on her way to recovery! I adopted Cookie a few months ago and to start she already needed surgery to remove a mammary gland tumor. I did that with my primary vet. However, when she recovered from this I noticed her knees did not look right. I was super stressed out about having to put her through another surgery so shortly after. Plus the cost of two surgeries so shortly doesn’t help! I spoke to a couple of different vets and felt that this hospital was the most genuine. They don’t overcharge or oversell unlike most vet hospitals these days. They are definitely reasonable. And most importantly they know what they are doing! At 8 years old, I was very worried about doing the bilateral patella surgery but she is healing so well. That is the surgeon’s skill. Also, shout out to Tina and staff for dealing with my ridiculous insurance company and their lack of competence. They were also very patient with my questions and my anxiety after her surgery when she had a weird reaction to the pain meds. She’s recovering very well! Three weeks post op and she’s starting to go on walks of about 1/3rd mile. Thanks Dr. Farrell! Excited to see her progress.

Update: we are over 6 months post op and cookie ran in our school field like a banchy! I was so happy to see it. Almost cried tears of joy. Thank you so much!

I can't thank the team at Animal Outpatient Surgery and their great team enough, for the great and phenomenal work they did on your baby girl. They took her in on a emergency surgery when other vets weren't confident in taking on the challenge. Their team and staff are nothing less then spectacular with great knowledge and confidence you want treating your loved pets. I would highly recommend anyone to consider Animal Outpatient Surgery for any of the needs and services for their pets.
Excellent service. They are very caring and attentive. I highly recommend this place.

Highly recommend! My vet (who is the best) recommended this place. My dog had her kneecap out of place and they determined it would require surgery. This particular surgeon has been doing specifically dog knees for many many years, and he talked me through everything, very honestly about pros and cons and costs and his recommendation and how the joints and all physically connect. They were open to quickly book an appointment followed by a very quick one the next day to perform the surgery, despite being somewhat busy. They did a great job and explained how to take care of my dog to get her to heal and didn't miss a single thing at any time. The surgeon is super nice. He's very calm and friendly. One checkin day, he was out and I talked to another surgeon who was also very nice. They seemed to have taken great care with my dog. Only had one procedure there, but from my 4 total visits everyone was very caring, knowledge, and helpful, including the two people managing the office. Highly recommend. As for insurance, they don't directly deal with insurance. They emailed me the invoice and I uploaded it to Nationwide and was reimbursed. My few visits I saw most other people that were in had dogs. There was usually around one person other than me who was being seen or waiting.

I really want to thank Dr. Farrell, And Chris and Angie and the entire team at Blue Sky Veterinarian Outpatient Surgery. They were able to perform a neuter and perineal hernia surgery on my 8 yr old Yorkie and Bichon mix.  I am extremely grateful for the very outstanding job they did and the very affordable price and the wonderful care.  I can't say enough about it!  I love you and the excellent and God centered organization you have there starting with Dr. Farrell   I am extremely blessed and forever grateful.  You will be too.  Dr.  Farrell gets it done with expertise compassion and respect for your hard earned money.  He is so good and will not rob you!

My family and I are beyond grateful to Dr. Farrell and his amazing staff for the care they provided to our dog, Francis. If I could give 10+ stars I would! What started as a very frightening situation turned into a life-saving experience thanks to their expertise and compassion.

Dr. Farrell quickly identified the problem and performed surgery to remove gauze that had been left inside Francis from a previous spay procedure done elsewhere. His knowledge, professionalism, and calm reassurance meant everything to us during such a stressful time.

The entire team treated Francis with incredible care and kindness, and they also supported our family every step of the way. They took the time to answer all of our questions and made sure Francis was comfortable and recovering well.

Because of Dr. Farrell and his staff, Francis now has the chance to heal and move forward. We cannot thank them enough for their skill, dedication, and genuine compassion. I would highly recommend Dr. Farrell to anyone needing exceptional veterinary surgical care.

The staff at animal outpatient surgery were so helpful when my dog Piper needed knee surgery. They were responsive and kind throughout the process.  He has recovered and his leg is stronger than ever. 😍

Dr. Farrell spent a lot of time with us going through the procedure step by step and answering all of our questions thoroughly. The office staff is very easy to contact via text with questions during the recovery phase and very supportive.  If our dog tears his other CCL (which is bound to happen), we will be right back at this same office for the next surgery!

All of the staff at this facility are very pet oriented. It was difficult accepting that our pet needed TLPO  knee surgery. Dr. Farrell  explained the surgery in terms that we would totally understand what he would do to repair her knee. Very impressed with all layers of the staff there. We just got her clearance from her surgery. Very close to being like new again. I highly recommend this facility for surgeries your pet may require. Dr. Farrell and all of his staff are very compassionate and caring and competent to help your little fur balls get better.

We’ve had two TPLO surgeries done now with our golden retriever and everything went well. Maybe a little difference in The surgeons protocol and I liked one better than the other. Both were very professional, and Tori is great too. My Golden is very active and we’re looking forward to her returning to being a retriever chasing that ball.

Our dog had knee surgery at Animal Outpatient.  Fantastic outcome!!! They were very communicative, appointments were on time, staff are friendly and checked on our dog throughout the recovery. Highly recommend.

I chose this place based on the reviews which I don’t understand. They get two stars because the support staff - Tina and and Tori - is good. The vet himself is arrogant and rude and the facility is questionable. You walk in past operating tables. “After care” was nonexistent. The prices were reasonable and the reviews are stellar but I would avoid this place at all costs.

Dog was showing signs of lameness and primary care referred to a specialist. Didn’t feel too confident with the specialist  and Then we were referred to  Animal Outpatient Surgery by a coworker.

Place is clean, easy to find, plenty of parking.

Staff is great! All the employees treat you like family and treat pets with kindness and compassion. Our dog an 80lb terrier mix has anxiety of the vet and felt extremely relaxed at this location.

First appointment, doctors recommended we wait on surgery as she wasn’t ready for surgery yet. Set home with anti inflammatory meds and instructions to come back when condition deteriorated.

Doctors explained surgery details and entire staff is supportive and compassionate.

We retuned a few months ladder and scheduled surgery.
Surgery Package was all inclusive( X-rays, surgery, post op meds, follow up appointments). Pricing was lower than other specialist. Dog is currently 6 months post surgery and almost back to normal. Staff was also available via text during non business hours for questions.

Unfortunately,  we will have to come back for surgery for our dog’s hind leg but we feel confidence with our experience and will definitely return to Animal Outpatient Surgery.

I had a consultation with another surgeon, the procedure was quoted significantly higher and the doctor didn’t want to do both of my dog’s knees at once (patella luxation), which made it way higher. I also did not feel like the first provider fully explained the procedure or answered my questions. Going to Animal Outpatient Surgery of San Diego was a breath of fresh air. Doctor spent time fully explaining the procedure, risks and recovery. The office was responsive and accommodating.

We brought our dog Quinn in for TPLO surgery following a CCL tear. I had decided this was our surgery team based on the first call with Tori and Tina. I am quite the anxious dog owner and they responded to me with such care and detail. Then with meeting the surgery team they walked through every detail before and after surgery. The way they got down and sat on the floor with Quinn while they spoke with me. The affection they showed him made me know he was in good hands. We are now finishing up recovery. Quinn is back to 2 mile walks a day (8 weeks post op) and just received his all clear to resume normal activity. I cannot thank this amazing staff enough. Thank you for giving our pup his quality of life back!

Our frenchie Tiny tot diagnosed with patella grade 3 on both leg at our regular vet. I got recommended to have surgery so I researched vet and found them! They are absolutely the best! Dr.Garofolo done Tibial Tuberosity Transposition on her both legs and She is running around again!
Their price is very reasonable and all the Dr. And staff are so nice and always answered my million questions!
She was even excited to go there for check up 😄
Thank you so much!!!! Highly recommend 😃

Coming in with a ruptured acl was our worst case scenario. I called a few outpatient clinics and Animal Outpatient Surgery of SD was the most responsive, educational, and cost effective. We knew exactly what we were getting. The recovery period is inherently hard, especially with active dogs. We were given very clear instructions on what’s expected and what we needed to focus on  at each stage of the recovery. What’s great is when we notified the team of additional redness/swelling, we were able to text a picture and received instant feedback and correction suggestions. We will likely need to go the other leg… and will definitely come here if needed. Our dog is now recovered, living his best life again. Thank you!

Our large-ish and skid-ish Shepherd mix had TPLO done here.  Before surgery she was basically lame in one of her legs after a tear, now she is able to walk/run/play again.  It was a major surgery and a major decision that has turned out positive.  Everyone at Animal Outpatient Surgery helped to make this happen, they know their stuff, do tons of these procedures and are a wonderful group of people.

We brought our dog Thule into AOSSD for a TPLO surgery in June. Dr. Farrell and his team were so attentive and informative about what the surgery entailed and gave us all the information necessary to make an informed decision. We felt very confident and comfortable with the support received from the team and decided to move forward with the surgery. We knew Thule was in good hands and received updates throughout the day during her surgery.

She is now 10 weeks post op and almost back to her fully active self. We are so thankful for the team at AOSSD for giving our sweet girl her full mobility back. Not to mention, they were much more cost efficient than the other places I researched and both my husband and I felt much more informed and confident in their team. Thank you so much, AOSSD!

My review is super late but I just wanted to thank the team here at AOSSD! They genuinely care about your pet!
I brought my dog in because he had a lump on his toe that I wanted to get taken off and my regular vet told me to amputate his toe since the skin is too tight around there. Instead I came here for a second opinion  and Dr easily said he could do it. My dog is a 9 yr old Doberman and he’s also been experiencing some prostate issues. I told Dr what’s going on and that we had just had a open body surgery to remove the mass from his prostate at VSH sorrento valley that was unsuccessful. They literally cut him open and closed him back up. So when I told this Dr here at AOSSD, he took a look at it using his ultrasound machine while my dog was under surgery for his toe. He later told me that his prostate is just enlarged, not that there was a mass. What I’m trying to say is that, Dr was so kind and didn’t charge me for the ultrasound! He also did a great job on my dogs toe and it healed perfectly! Honestly if this was a regular vet office I would choose to go here for all my pets.

Dr Farrell and his staff are wonderful! I am a new patient met with him this week regarding my Pomeranian who has collapsing trachea. Dr Farrell was so thorough, explained what happens when a trachea collapses, how to help your dog when they're experiencing it and how to protect them from future issues. The detailed information he gave me was in layman's terms that I completely , and he confirmed she did not need surgery I am elated. He is honest and kind and trustworthy. Prior to him I had two consultations with two other vets in Carlsbad and San Marcos that told me she needed $8,000 which I did not believe and because she's a senior I did not want to do. I adopted her 2 years ago from Tijuana with barely any medical records . He confirmed my thoughts and gave me so much comfort, it was so appreciated, I highly recommend him.

Update: it’s been 1.5 years since Scooter’s surgery and he is living his best life on 4 healthy, functional legs! It’s hard to remember the time we carried him up and down stairs - at 11 years old now, he zooms up and down faster than we can!
———-
Animal Outpatient Surgery is a pretty incredible place and one of the best veterinary experiences I've ever had. When our 10 yr old chihuahua, Scooter, tore his left CCL we were feeling so defeated when a local clinic gave us an astronomical quote for the CCL repair.

We know these things can happen and have an emergency fund for our pups, but we wanted to look for alternatives in the spirit of stretching that emergency fund, and good thing too, because our other dog needed an unexpected major surgery the following month. Dogs man, amirite?

That's when we found AOS on a google search. I shared our pre-op diagnostics and got an initial estimate within 24 hours. We live 2.5-3hrs from the clinic so this was so helpful to handle over email, of course understanding the estimate may change after the physical exam.

Scheduling and coordinating with Tina and Tori was so easy and professional. On the day of the physical exam and surgery everything went so smoothly. The doctor was patient in his explanation of the procedures he would conduct and made sure my questions were answered. All of the staff have a wonderful bedside manner and are loving and sweet with their patients.

We were able to not only repair the left CLL, but also correct both of Scooter's grade 3 luxating patellas and pre-emptively stabilize the right CCL all for less than the cost we were quoted locally. And while price is a critical factor, it is only one piece of the puzzle. Quality, compassion, and expertise were in no way lacking and we felt extremely confident Scooter was in good hands.

Go-home instructions were abundantly clear and the ability to text with recovery/post-op questions put my mind at ease. We followed up in person at the 2-week and 8-week marks, and both visits were efficient and positive. As of the writing of this review, we are almost 11 weeks post-op and Scooter is walking as much as he did prior to surgery, going up and down stairs (a big deal for a little guy), and running around the house with his stuffie. We know it will take many more weeks for him to fully recover his strength, but we see it returning consistently.

Thank you AOS for offering quality veterinary care that isn't out of reach. We appreciate you and if we ever need orthopedic surgery in the future, you will be our first call. Many thanks!

My dog Rocky had TPLO surgery, the staff was amazing and extremely patient with us(trust me I can be a lot when it involves my babies) They made themselves available whenever I had any questions or concerns. Could not recommend them more

The Animal Outpatient Surgery of San Diego came highly recommended by our vet, when our 7 year old pittie mix tore his CCL and MCL. Everyone here is very respectful, knowledgeable, patient, and understanding of our needs and questions. We learned a lot just from our 1st visit here! We felt at ease knowing our boy was going to receive the best care. I would highly recommend the Animal Outpatient Surgery of SD to any pet parent looking for a surgeon!

The Surgery Center was amazing. They responded so quick every time I had questions. And I had many questions. They made me feel comfortable and made me feel secure that I was making the right decision for my dog  My dog has been a whole different dog since his surgery. He’s loving life pain free. And they were so sweet to my dog, Eddie. He’s a big chicken and he loved them.
Great staff kept us updated. Love it good experiencr

I can’t speak highly enough of Animal Outpatient Surgery of San Diego. Our seven-year-old Chesapeake Bay Retriever needed TPLO surgery, and the entire experience—from consultation to recovery—was outstanding.

The staff were incredibly professional, compassionate, and knowledgeable. They took the time to walk us through the procedure, answered all our questions, and made sure we felt comfortable every step of the way. The clinic itself is spotless and well-equipped, which added to our peace of mind.

The surgery went smoothly, and the post-op care has been exceptional. They provided detailed recovery instructions, followed up regularly, and were always available when we had concerns. Thanks to their expertise and attentive care, our dog is now well on her way to a full recovery.

We’re so grateful to the team at Animal Outpatient Surgery of San Diego for treating our dog like family. Highly recommend them to anyone needing surgical care for their animal.

After an extensive search for a vet service to help us with our dog’s second TPLO surgery, it was clear that AOSSD was who we needed to help us.  The staff was exceptional and very experienced to answer our questions and follow through in the great care for our dog.   Highly recommend and thank you!
Very good and caring staff. They empathetically show you all your options and with utmost care do the best for your pet. Terrific work and awesome customer service

Called to set up an appointment for a surgery and they denied saying the patient was not a good candidate for surgery. Apparently they do not want to mess up again. They just did a surgery for us last year and when they placed the drain lines they did not go to the bottom of the wound sac which led to massive fluid build up, the wound never healed correctly becoming infected and we had to go elsewhere to get assistance to heal the wound. They were professional at the beginning but being complacent was at our pet's expense
My Rottie ruptured both ACL’s. Dr. Farrell and his staff were great, thorough, and her surgery result was excellent.

Found this place on Google, saw all the other excellent reviews. They only do surgery so in my opinion no better place to go if surgery is what’s needed.

Responsiveness was great, I was able to text and they immediately replied with an answer.

Gave excellent post surgical instructions.

Worked great with my pet insurance, no complications.

My dog is now 8 weeks out and doing great, back and playing.

My dog has needed two CCL (similar to a ACL in a human) each back leg about 1 year apart. The team & doctor is great, handle the dog with care, explained the process & held our hand throughout the process & through PT. They are also about $2k less expensive. Thanks you guys & gals. JoeC

I am so grateful to Animal Outpatient Surgery! They took great care of my dog when he had a CCL tear. Dr. Garofolo thoroughly explained the procedure to me and patiently answered all my questions. The follow up care instructions were clear and easy to follow. All the staff members we met were friendly and they obviously love dogs. Prices were more reasonable than the emergency hospital we were referred to originally, and there were no surprise fees. My dog is doing great now. Thank you so much to the entire team! We appreciate you!
Great experience, I'm so glad I choose them!

Regarding our experience with a knee joint ligament (TPLO) surgery. AOSSD is “Small but mighty”in staff size and building space! They’ve got this process down! Perhaps why the surgery was so competitive in price.We were worried that our dog Buddy was too old to handle the procedure…a12 yr old part lab, but for a quality of life we knew we had to try it! After 80 days of caution, Today we got thumbs up to return normal with play and exercise! Thanks Dr. Farrell and your team.

Amazing surgeons, awesome staff! They handled both my dog and me with care and compassion through a really tough time, and gave me such hope for our future. Bluesky is absolutely wonderful, thank you so much for everything 💙 …

We brought our pup Koa in for a neuter and the team at Animal Outpatient Surgery of San Diego took the best care of him! From start to finish they were thorough and made sure to answer any questions and concerns I had. They took there time with us and I really appreciate that. He’s well on route to healing and it’s all thanks to their competence!

Outstanding skilled vets . My 7 month old Chinese Crested had surgery here for a badly broken foot. He had a titanium plate put in and it has healed beautifully. The staff and doctors are deeply knowledgeable and personable. The pricing in reasonable and included several post surgery appointments. Hugo was taken care of beautifully. I highly recommend Animal Outpatient Surgery!

I can’t say enough wonderful things about Animal Outpatient Surgery of San Diego! My dog, Malakai, underwent TPLO surgery here, and the experience exceeded all of my expectations. From start to finish, the entire staff and doctors were incredibly compassionate, professional, and thorough.

They took the time to explain the procedure in detail, answered all my questions, and made sure I felt comfortable with every step. Malakai’s recovery has been remarkable, thanks to their expertise and the clear post-op care instructions they provided.

The staff consistently went above and beyond, checking in on Malakai and ensuring he was progressing well. It’s clear they genuinely care about their patients and their families.

I wholeheartedly recommend Animal Outpatient Surgery of San Diego to anyone looking for skilled and caring professionals to handle their pet’s surgical needs. Malakai is back on his feet and as happy as ever, and I am so grateful for their exceptional care!

The staff and veterinarians at Animal Outpatient Surgery of San Diego are very kind and caring. The consult appointment was relaxed, all questions answered and they offered bloodwork. On the day of surgery the drop off and pick up were easy and  they communicated at each step. I had some questions when home and Tina answered my questions promptly.  Dr Farrel did a great job with Piper’s salivary mucocele surgery and there were no complications.  Healing was very smooth.  Did I mention the cost was less than other quotes and made it possible and affordable.  They are super stars 🌟 You will love the care provided here.

Dr. Farrell and his team are amazing. As an owner of a dog that has now had 2 TPLOs (both legs both with Dr. Farrell) and 1 lateral suture in the span of 2 years, I would be lost without them. They are direct, responsive, honest, great communicators who truly are experts in the field. I am so glad I was referred to them and so happy that our 9 year old Australian Shepherd is on the road to recovery. Additionally, I found their pricing to be very reasonable and their ability to make time so that my dog was not waiting to long for surgery was priceless. Thank you!

My husband and I had some fear around getting the TPLO surgery for our 7 year old Siberian Husky suffering from a torn cranial cruciate ligament. At our initial visit, we were educated thoroughly and concisely about our dog’s anatomy, the surgical process, and the benefits and risks of the procedure. I am glad we decided to trust their word rather than the typical fears circulating around the “invasive” TPLO procedure. Their facilities were clean, their staff was attentive and experienced, and the entire process was seamless from start to finish. After following their detailed pre and post op instructions, our friends and family were shocked by how quickly our dog recovered. Since we rescued him, we have never seen him in better shape and able to move with such range of motion. We couldn’t be more grateful. I advise that anyone in a similar situation set up a conversation with these folks first, as they are clearly experienced in what they do and will probably offer you the best education about these topics that you can get.

Update: We got our dog’s second leg done here a few months later and followed the same protocol. He is now fully healed and in better shape than we’ve ever seen him in. Very grateful for this place!
Great doctors, great staff and great results! Our Great Pyrenees is back walking normally and enjoying life!

My dog received TPLO surgery on both knees within the last 4 months and is doing great. The staff is very professional and understanding. I would definitely recommend them to anyone that needs to get this surgery

I LOVE THIS PLACE! My dog, Cecilio, had his second TPLO surgery (other knee) at the end of September and the whole team are amazing. Leaving your fur baby for surgery is already stressful enough but they were so amazing the first time around, that this second one was just easier to drop him off. They are there for you the whole way. They respond to texts with any concerns! It's one of those places where you hope you never have to see them again but want to. I 1000% recommend. Thank you AOS for all you do!!

Dr. Farrell and his team at AOSSD get 100 stars from me and my little Izzy.

The thought of having my 4-year-old, 10.6 pound fur-baby undergo surgery to repair a luxating patella was a bit nerve-wracking for me. I did A LOT of research to find a veterinary surgeon who I could feel confident was the right choice. My search focused on credentials, experience, expertise, outcomes, and the entire patient and family experience. My findings kept leading me back to Dr. Farrell and his team at AOSSD. I read enough of the 180-plus Google reviews at that time — all 180-plus were five stars — that I felt confident in bringing Izzy to Dr. Farrell, at least for a consultation.

Dr. Farrell and his team are everything I was hoping to find and more. They are genuinely passionate about helping their furry patients live their best lives, strive for great outcomes, communicate clearly and transparently throughout the process, care about creating a positive experience for their patients and  patients’ families, they are kind and they have heart.

I was blown away by how Dr. Farrell handled a life-or-death situation that was unfolding with a different patient during our consultation. When it became critical for the other patient to immediately go to a different nearby facility for a specialized service not provided at AOSSD, Dr. Farrell sent two staff members to go with the patient and their family to facilitate the patient’s admission. Who does that??? That was when I knew with 100% certainty that Izzy would be in the right hands.

My confidence was well-placed. Izzy’s surgery was successful, and he’s well on the way to a full recovery.

Thank you Dr. Farrell, Tina, Tori, Chris and the rest of the AOSSD team! You are the best!

I recently brought my cat, Tippy to Animal Outpatient Surgery of San Diego for oral surgery, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. The clinic was incredibly clean and welcoming, and the staff was so friendly and professional throughout the entire process. They were on time, thorough, and extremely thoughtful in their care for Tippy. It’s clear they genuinely care about their patients, and their attention to detail gave me a lot of confidence. I highly recommend Animal Outpatient Surgery to anyone looking for exceptional veterinary care. Thank you!
My 8 year old golden retriever, Luna, had her ACL repaired here and we could not be happier with the results. The team was amazing throughout and I thoroughly recommend them. Perfection.

When you select the right veterinarian, there are no problems at all! Thank you Dr. Farrel and your team for helping Beauty with her knees. We had the bad luck of experiencing an incompetent and unprofessional veterinarian before and Beauty …
Thanks everyone that works here!  Sunny is healed!

My husband and I were referred to Dr. Paul Farrell through our vet for our dog’s double knee CCL tears. Left knee tear happened in 2022 and the right happened in July 2024. CCLs never heal but it seemed as though our dog was living with the …

This review is long overdue. Our Pomeranian, Tiki, suffered from bilateral patellar luxation very early in his life. My wife and I went to several veterinarians and had consultations with a few veterinary surgeons before choosing Dr. …
The staff are always welcoming and friendly. They provide the best service.

Dr Farrell and his team are fantastic. They were very prompt in replying to my inquiry, scheduling a consult and ultimately scheduling our dogs surgery. We had been told by 3 other places they would not perform the surgery on our dogs anal …
Our dog absolutely thrived after the surgery. The team couldn’t have been more informative and helpful and caring.
